title: Have lunch on the Steamboat NATCHEZ
description: Board the Steamboat NATCHEZ near the French Quarter and watch New Orleans recede as the Mississippi carries you past its busy port. A daytime cruise offers live narration and jazz, with lunch available aboard. Between bites, step outside for river air and a view that explains why the city grew along this bend.
teaser: See New Orleans from the river over lunch and jazz.
goodToKnow: Before you go, confirm operating vessel, lunch format, accessible boarding and seating.
whyItMightDelightYou: The moving view connects the city’s music, food, and river history in one easy afternoon.
